wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview

Provide an overview of the main user workflows from content discovery to itinerary creation and sharing.

# Argo: AI-Powered Itinerary Planning Platform - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## 1. Project Introduction

**Argo** is an intelligent travel planning application that transforms saved links into actionable travel itineraries. The platform analyzes videos and articles to extract travel locations, organizes them into collections, and generates day-by-day itineraries that respect opening hours and travel times between destinations.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Intelligent Content Analysis**: Automatically extract travel-related locations from URLs (videos, articles, blogs)
- **Collection Management**: Organize discovered locations into thematic collections
- **AI-Powered Itinerary Generation**: Create optimized daily schedules considering location proximity, opening hours, and travel logistics
- **Collaborative Planning**: Enable sharing and collaboration on travel plans
- **Map Integration**: Visualize locations and routes on interactive maps

### Target Audience
- Travel enthusiasts planning trips
- Content creators who discover travel destinations through media
- Groups organizing collaborative travel experiences
- Individuals seeking AI-assisted trip planning solutions

## 2. Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern React-based architecture using Next.js 15 with TypeScript, implementing a component-driven design pattern with comprehensive state management.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Next.js App Router] --> B[Root Layout]
    B --> C[QueryProvider]
    B --> D[ThemeProvider]
    B --> E[ToastProvider]
    
    C --> F[React Query Client]
    F --> G[Supabase Client]
    
    H[Dashboard Page] --> I[Content Grid]
    H --> J[Job Queue System]
    H --> K[Map Clusters]
    
    I --> L[Card Components]
    L --> M[Itinerary Cards]
    L --> N[Collection Cards]
    L --> O[Link Cards]
    L --> P[Location Cards]
    
    J --> Q[Content Analysis Jobs]
    J --> R[Itinerary Planning Jobs]
    
    S[Navigation Routes] --> T[Home]
    S --> U[Collections]
    S --> V[Itineraries]
    S --> W[Links]
```

### Component Breakdown

The application is structured around several key architectural layers:

**Presentation Layer**: React components organized by feature and type
- **Primitives**: Basic UI building blocks (Button, Input, Modal, etc.)
- **Cards**: Content display components for different entity types
- **Layouts**: Structural components for page organization
- **Modals**: Interactive dialog components for user input

**Business Logic Layer**: Custom hooks managing complex state and data operations
- **Data Fetching**: React Query hooks for server state management
- **Real-time Updates**: WebSocket integration for live job status
- **User State**: Authentication and preference management

**Data Layer**: Supabase integration for database operations
- **Authentication**: User management and session handling
- **Database Operations**: CRUD operations for all entities
- **File Storage**: Image and document management

### Design Patterns

The project implements several key design patterns:

1. **Component Composition**: Reusable UI components built from primitives
2. **Custom Hooks Pattern**: Encapsulated business logic in reusable functions
3. **Context API**: Global state management for theme, notifications, and navigation
4. **Server-Side Rendering**: Optimized performance with Next.js SSR capabilities
5. **Error Boundaries**: Graceful error handling throughout the application

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Application Root** (`src/app/layout.tsx`): Configures global providers including theme management, query client, toast notifications, and typography settings.

**Dashboard Page** (`src/app/home/page.tsx`): The main landing page featuring a bento-grid layout with recent content, job queue management, and map cluster visualization.

### Core Modules

**State Management** (`src/contexts/`): 
- Toast notifications system
- Navigation loading states
- Right sidebar management
- Filter contexts for search functionality

**Data Layer** (`src/lib/supabase/`):
- Supabase client configuration
- Database queries for all entity types
- Real-time subscriptions for live updates

**API Layer** (`src/lib/api/`):
- RESTful API clients for external services
- Error handling and retry logic
- Authentication middleware

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Configuration** (`next.config.js`):
- Image optimization with remote patterns
- Experimental features for package imports
- Development indicators disabled for production

**TypeScript Configuration** (`tsconfig.json`):
- Strict type checking enabled
- Path aliases for cleaner imports
- Module resolution for modern JavaScript features

### External Dependencies

Key dependencies include:
- **UI Framework**: Base UI components with Tailwind CSS styling
- **State Management**: React Query for server state, Context API for client state
- **Database**: Supabase for real-time database and authentication
- **Maps**: Google Maps integration for location visualization
- **Animations**: Motion library for smooth transitions and interactions
- **Drag & Drop**: DnD Kit for interactive card arrangements

### Integration Points

**Supabase Integration**: Real-time database operations, file storage, and authentication
**Google Maps API**: Location search, mapping, and geocoding services
**Content Analysis**: External AI service for extracting travel information from URLs
**Payment Processing**: Stripe integration for subscription management

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User Interface
    participant Dashboard as Dashboard Page
    participant JobQueue as Job Queue Hook
    participant Supabase as Supabase Database
    participant AI as AI Service
    
    User->>Dashboard: Submit URL for analysis
    Dashboard->>JobQueue: Create content-analysis job
    JobQueue->>Supabase: Store job metadata
    JobQueue->>AI: Send URL for processing
    AI-->>JobQueue: Return extracted locations
    JobQueue->>Supabase: Update job status
    JobQueue->>Dashboard: Notify completion
    Dashboard->>Supabase: Refresh content list
```

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Content Analysis Pipeline**: Automated extraction of travel locations from various content sources including YouTube videos, blog posts, and news articles.

**Smart Collection Management**: Organize discovered locations into themed collections with automatic categorization and tagging.

**AI-Generated Itineraries**: Intelligent itinerary creation that considers factors like:
- Geographic proximity between locations
- Business hours and operating schedules
- Travel time calculations
- User preferences and constraints

**Interactive Map Visualization**: Real-time map integration showing location clusters, suggested routes, and detailed place information.

### Implementation Highlights

**Real-time Job Queue** (`src/hooks/useJobsQueue.ts`): Manages background processing tasks with live status updates and progress tracking.

**Infinite Scrolling** (`src/hooks/useInfiniteScroll.ts`): Efficiently loads large datasets with virtual scrolling and pagination.

**Map Clustering** (`src/hooks/useMapClusters.ts`): Groups nearby locations for better visualization and performance optimization.

**Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with adaptive layouts for different screen sizes and interaction patterns.

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Analyzing: Submit URL
    Analyzing --> Success: Locations Found
    Analyzing --> Failed: No Content
    Success --> CreatingItinerary: Add to Collection
    Success --> ViewingDetails: View Extracted Data
    CreatingItinerary --> Generating: Process AI Recommendations
    Generating --> Complete: Itinerary Ready
    Failed --> Idle: Retry
    Complete --> [*]: Export/Share
```

The application demonstrates sophisticated state management through custom hooks, efficient data fetching with React Query, and a well-organized component hierarchy that promotes reusability and maintainability. The integration of real-time features, AI-powered content analysis, and interactive mapping creates a comprehensive travel planning experience.
